Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:176262
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 39935 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt Meena Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhilasha Singh,Ashutosh Yadav,Shyam Lal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Ashutosh Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA for the State.
2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 326 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Jaithra,
District Etah during pendency of the trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter along with her other family members including husband of the deceased.
4. He further submits that actually unfortunately father-in-law of the deceased i.e. husband of the applicant suffered with paralytic attack and after treatment at Delhi he returned to his home and son of the applicant told his wife i.e. deceased to take care of him but his wife refused for the same and thereafter some altercation took place between husband and wife and after that in anger Smt Meena Devi vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16463642/

sentences.text: deceased committed suicide by hanging herself.
5. He further submits, according to post mortem report, deceased died due to hanging.

He further submits, however, post mortem report suggests that apart from the ligature mark deceased sustained some superficial abrasions and contusions but it reflects, during the altercation between husband and wife, wife sustained these injuries and applicant is having no concern with the altercation took place between husband and wife.
6.
He further submits that applicant is a lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is 68 years old.

7. He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 01.05.2024 i.e. for last more than six months.
8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits, applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and her daughter-in-law died within five months of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and however,
as per autopsy surgeon deceased died due to hanging but on her body number of contusions and superficial abrasions were found but could not dispute the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant.
Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that father-in-law of the deceased suffered with paralysis attack.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. However, it reflects, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within five months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.

11. Further, post mortem report, however suggests that deceased sustained some contusions and superficial abrasions but cause of death, as per autopsy surgeon, is hanging, therefore, at this stage,
it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death specially considering the reason of contusion and superficial abrasions sustained by the deceased given by the learned counsel for the applicant during the course of argument, which cannot be completely brushed aside.
12. Further, applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 01.05.2024 i.e. for last more than six months.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: 15. Let the applicant - Smt Meena Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
